Why this design · hypothesis and evidence
Hypothesis: A referring dentist can identify the action, owner, timing, and unresolved information more easily when the same approved report is presented as focused cards. The full report remains available for context.
What to test: Ask the recipient to identify those details in their own words, and compare accuracy and time with their current report. This interface does not establish that current reports are inadequate or that a practice will buy it. Read the evidence and test rules.


Fictional case and identities. Drafting, clinician approval, and handoff are simulated. TXT export works locally; no messages are sent. State clears on refresh or reset.
